paper.title: Wearable Epileptic Seizure Prediction System with Machine-Learning-Based Anomaly Detection of Heart Rate Variability
paper.claim: The paper uses multivariate statistical process control over eight HRV indices to identify a sustained preictal anomaly during continuous awake monitoring.
paper.population: The fitted model used interictal data from fourteen refractory-epilepsy patients and was prospectively evaluated on fourteen seizures from seven diagnosed patients during inpatient video-EEG monitoring.
paper.referenceStandard: Specialist-adjudicated awake seizure onset and clean interictal periods from synchronized clinical video, EEG, and ECG.
paper.relationEvidence: The CC-BY paper does not publish code, fitted loadings, scaling parameters, or training data. The supplied BSD-licensed repository predates the paper and implements a different patient-specific EEG+ECG deep-learning system.

compatibility.brainstemContract: not-defined: proposed continuous epilepsy HRV and specialist-adjudicated event contract
requiredSignals: continuous artifact-screened beat-to-beat intervals sufficient for eight paper-defined HRV indices
diagnosed epilepsy context with specialist-adjudicated awake seizure onset and interictal periods
compatibility.window: Three-minute moving HRV window monitored continuously; the paper counts an alert when an anomaly persists for more than ten seconds within the fifteen-minute pre-seizure horizon.
compatibility.preprocessing: Withheld until licensed epilepsy data and an exact implementation freeze R-R correction, interpolation, autoregressive spectral estimation, feature order, scaling, fitted principal components, control limits, temporal state, and uncertainty.
mismatches: Brainstem resting recordings are not continuous awake monitoring before a seizure.
Brainstem has no specialist-adjudicated seizure onset, interictal, sleep, motion-artifact, or epileptiform-event labels.
The paper's fitted loadings, scaling parameters, control limits, and training data are not public.
The paper population consists of diagnosed refractory-epilepsy patients under inpatient video-EEG monitoring.
The supplied repository implements a different EEG+ECG deep-learning system and cannot establish implementation provenance.
